Announcements From The Auditor
Our Levy Tool has been updated with details for the November 3, 2026, General Election.
Existing Parcel Scenario – To see the potential property tax levy impact on your parcel:
• Search for your parcel.
• Any levies impacting the parcel will appear on the main page, just below the Tab Navigation Links.
What-If Scenario – To see the potential property tax levy impact based on a potential market value:
• In the upper-right corner, click Tools and select Levy Calculator .
• Enter the potential market value.
• Select the levy you’re interested in.
• Select Residential / Agricultural or Commercial / Industrial property type.
• Click Compute .
Welcome!
Fairfield County Auditor
Real Estate Assessment Website
Welcome to the Fairfield County Auditor's Office Real Estate Assessment website. We are pleased to provide Fairfield County residents, property owners, businesses, and real estate professionals with convenient online access to a wide range of property and assessment information. Whether you are researching a property, checking ownership details, reviewing tax and valuation information, exploring maps and aerial imagery, or learning more about the assessment process, this website is designed to make information easy to find and simple to understand. Our goal is to provide transparent, accessible, and user-friendly resources that help keep our community informed.
County Auditors serve important roles in local government throughout the State of Ohio. In addition to serving as the chief financial officer for the county, the Auditor is responsible for maintaining records for all real property within the county and ensuring properties are assessed fairly and according to Ohio law. This website focuses on those real estate assessment responsibilities and provides helpful tools and educational resources to better explain the process. You can also view a short video highlighting the many responsibilities of the County Auditor and learn more about how the office serves the public every day.
The Fairfield County Auditor's Office works to establish property values that reflect current market conditions, administer property tax reductions and exemptions, and provide the information used to calculate local property taxes that support schools, municipalities, townships, libraries, parks, and other essential public services. This website includes educational videos covering the assessment process, recent property tax reforms, and other topics that impact property owners throughout Fairfield County.
We hope you find this website helpful, informative, and easy to use. We encourage you to explore the many tools and resources available online, and we remain committed to providing responsive service, current information, and continued support to the citizens of Fairfield County.

Website Navigation
Within the upper right hand side of the website, you will find our Property Search Box and several links to assist you in navigating our website.
SEARCH BAR: Property information for a single parcel may be accessed by using the quick search bar by entering the Parcel Number, Owners Name (Last Name, First Name), or Address.
SEARCH LINK: For more complex search functions, this link expands your search options including searching multiple parcels.
MAP LINK: Use this link to a ccess and interact with our GIS Parcel Viewer.
INFO LINK: Follow this link y o view information on the various services and announcements from the Fairfield County Auditor.
FORM LINK: With this link, you have access to and ability to download the common forms used within the County Auditor's office.
TOOLS LINK: M ultiple reports are available such as Sales Report, Sales List, Delinquency Report. Additionally you will find Calculators including the Conveyance Fee Calculator and Tax Estimator for your convenience.
